headline: Frontlines Shift as Bases Flip Across Sectors
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the most volatile sectors have deepened their churn. Weathered Expanse remains the hottest zone, recording forty‑eight base transitions in the past day and two in the last two hours, with Colonial losses rising to 188 per hour and Warden losses to 285 per hour. Nevish Line still leads total daily flips at fifty‑four, though no new transitions appeared in the latest window while Warden casualties accelerate toward three hundred per hour. Linn Mercy has surged further, logging three ownership changes in the past two hours and sixteen in the day, both sides’ loss rates climbing sharply to 197 and 462 per hour respectively. Marban Hollow shows a similar spike with seven flips in two hours and seventeen in twenty‑four, casualties accelerating on both sides. Kuura Strand continues its modest but accelerating turnover, four flips in two hours and twelve daily, with casualties rising. Stlican Shelf has added two recent flips and five daily, its loss rates also climbing. Meanwhile Farranac Coast and Godcrofts have tapered, Mooring County added two fresh flips, and the massive meat‑grinders at Callahans Passage and Dead Lands bleed heavily without base movement. Enlistment spikes persist across all contested fronts, suggesting the current flare‑ups may sustain through the next day.
